coverage.text: User can enter a discount code in the cart
Valid codes apply the discount to the total
coverage.clarified_as: Valid codes are SAVE10 (10% off) and FLAT20 ($20 off, only when subtotal >= $50, otherwise refused with 'This code needs a subtotal of at least $50.'). On the $120 cart: SAVE10 -> $108.00, FLAT20 -> $100.00. One code at a time: a second code replaces the first. Showing the discount line and new total in the cart is enough; reload/checkout out of scope. Expiry not checked for this story; letter case is accepted risk and not tested. (Q-1, Q-6, Q-AI-1, Q-AI-2, Q-AI-3, Q-AI-4, Q-AI-6)

Empty code shows exactly 'Enter a discount code.'; unknown code shows exactly 'That code is not valid.'; the total stays $120.00. A bad code entered after SAVE10 removes the SAVE10 discount. (Q-2, Q-AI-5)
